row.notes: Vtable slot 0x80 of unnamed VM vtable 0x1457270c0 (pointer 0x145727140); switch on the djb2 hash in edx. 0xb2adfe87: if Ne_Get_FeatureFlags 0x1413ca0d0 byte0 bit 0x80 is set (add-on drivers owned) enables option add_on_drivers (Game_OptionsStore_FindOption 0x142b5dfd0 on [vm+0x290]+0x270, vt+0x18(1)), sets up the career component and the ai_can_recruit_icon option, pushes wizard step 0x15 (0x14386d780 on [vm+0x270]), posts a bus message (0x1457327f0, code 0) and routes. Else reads UI.skipDLCUpsell via Ne_Get_SettingBool on [vm+0x380]+0x18, default 0: if set, pushes step 0x16 and routes on (skip); if clear, posts the message with code 1 and opens popup career_wizard_addon_drivers_locked (0x142427f30 on [vm+0x298]), i.e. the DLC upsell. 0xa96c1ef4: disables add_on_drivers, step 0x16, message code 2, route. 0x9b1bf96c: if feature byte3 bit 4, step 0x1f, message code 3. The route name comes from table 0x145736988 indexed by the last wizard step (Vm_Fire_Route 0x1442c0e20). hidden-modes 2026-11-13 (vmknolle-hidden-a): read from the Ghidra decompile.
